text: I do not give trade instructions or contract counts; sizing comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units and the decision stays with Bernardo. The facts: US corn 2026/27 stocks-to-use is 11.3% at the 42nd percentile since 2007/08 (WASDE 2026-10-09), and corn volatility on WASDE days has run 1.314 times the 10 days either side (t 5.2, 295 releases), which says the 10 November report tends to move the price, not which way. Inference: a mid-range percentile is not by itself a tight balance, so the stocks figure alone does not make a directional case.
